metadata.title: Bengaluru Commercial & Residential Hubs (Urban Pockets)
metadata.description: Authoritative spatial polygon layers demarcating high-density commercial high streets / tech corridors vs affluent & high-density residential layouts.

properties.name: Indiranagar 100ft Road & 12th Main High Street
properties.synergy_rationale: Flagship fashion, cafes, and rooftop breweries create continuous pedestrian footfall; prime post-meal dessert impulse corridor.
properties.dominant_profile: Affluent Young Professionals, Tech Executives & Shoppers
properties.summary: Bengaluru's #1 lifestyle and dining high street with unmatched evening dessert demand.

properties.name: CMH Road & Indiranagar Metro Transit Commercial Hub
properties.synergy_rationale: Massive daily commuter volume from Purple Line Metro station, jewellery stores, and electronics retail drives rapid grab-and-go walk-ins.
properties.dominant_profile: Daily Metro Commuters, Family Shoppers & Office Employees
properties.summary: Dense transit retail arterial linking Indiranagar station directly to Old Madras Road.

properties.name: Koramangala 5th & 7th Block Gourmet High Street
properties.synergy_rationale: Epicenter of Bengaluru's startup, college, and casual dining scene; highest density of late-night dessert seekers in South Bangalore.
properties.dominant_profile: College Cohorts (JNC), Startup Founders, Young Couples
properties.summary: Highest-velocity youth dining strip in South Bangalore with non-stop midnight footfall.

properties.name: Koramangala 80 Feet Road & Sony World Junction
properties.synergy_rationale: High-visibility crossroads connecting Koramangala blocks with Inner Ring Road; showroom shoppers and corporate lunch crowd.
properties.dominant_profile: Corporate Professionals, Auto & Electronics Shoppers
properties.summary: Major arterial junction connecting tech parks, dining corridors, and luxury residential.

properties.name: HSR Layout 27th Main Commercial Spine
properties.synergy_rationale: The dining lifeline of HSR Layout; combines heavy weekday tech-worker lunches with weekend family dining and dessert strolling.
properties.dominant_profile: Tech Startup Workforce, Affluent Nuclear Families, College Youth
properties.summary: Premier South-East Bangalore high street with massive post-spicy meal ice cream capture.

properties.name: HSR Layout 19th & 14th Main Startup Tech Hub
properties.synergy_rationale: Venture-backed startup offices, incubators, and co-working spaces drive strong afternoon beverage and dessert group orders.
properties.dominant_profile: Software Engineers, Product Managers, Founders
properties.summary: Dense startup ecosystem generating heavy corporate team dessert and afternoon walkouts.

properties.name: Jayanagar 4th Block Shopping Complex & 11th Main
properties.category: Heritage Family Market & Modern High Street
properties.synergy_rationale: South Bangalore's ultimate family retail hub; multi-generational shopping rituals followed by ice cream at Cool Joint and Apsara.
properties.dominant_profile: Multi-generational Families, Shoppers, Students (National College)
properties.summary: Historic high-footfall family retail district with unmatched weekend evening crowds.

properties.name: Gandhi Bazaar & DVG Road Heritage Market Corridor
properties.category: Heritage Pedestrian Market & Traditional Street Food
properties.synergy_rationale: Centuries-old pedestrian shopping promenade; high evening walker density, cultural pride, and immense vegetarian dessert appetite.
properties.dominant_profile: Traditional Kannadiga Families, Heritage Food Walkers, College Youth
properties.summary: Iconic cultural and food district where evening ice cream strolls are a decades-old family ritual.

properties.name: JP Nagar 24th Main Commercial District (Phases 2 & 7)
properties.synergy_rationale: High-density neighborhood dining strip serving affluent residential phases; dense concentration of bakeries, cafes, and restaurants.
properties.dominant_profile: Established Resident Families, Software Engineers, Retired Executives
properties.summary: Primary lifestyle corridor for South Bangalore's affluent planned residential phases.

properties.name: Whitefield ITPL & EPIP Tech-Corporate Corridor
properties.category: Corporate IT Hub & Premium Mall District
properties.synergy_rationale: Massive daytime IT workforce combined with Nexus Shantiniketan mall entertainment traffic drives both corporate lunch and weekend family footfall.
properties.dominant_profile: Global IT Professionals, Expat Families, Corporate Teams
properties.summary: India's pioneer tech corridor generating immense corporate daytime and weekend retail spend.

properties.name: Bellandur Outer Ring Road (ORR) IT Corridor & Ecospace
properties.synergy_rationale: Highest daytime office worker density in Karnataka; massive lunch break, evening tea break, and group catering dessert demand.
properties.dominant_profile: Fortune 500 Tech Employees, Financial Analysts, Young Migrants
properties.summary: Mega tech corridor driving unrivaled corporate weekday volume and team orders.

properties.name: Malleshwaram 8th Cross & Sampige Road Heritage Strip
properties.synergy_rationale: High-density shopping street with dense foot traffic for jewellery, silk sarees, and festive shopping; iconic CTR tiffin crowd converts directly into dessert sales.
properties.dominant_profile: Traditional Multi-gen Families, Heritage Food Enthusiasts, Women Shoppers
properties.summary: North-West Bangalore's crown jewel of traditional retail footfall and evening walking culture.

properties.name: Hennur Main Road & Kothanur Commercial High Street
properties.synergy_rationale: Booming residential highway connecting ORR to international airport; rapidly filling with multi-cuisine dining, hypermarkets, and young family dessert parlors.
properties.dominant_profile: Airport Corridor Commuters, Gated Community Families, Expat Groups
properties.summary: Fastest-growing North-East arterial with expanding family dining and leisure footprints.

properties.name: Yelahanka New Town (Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan Rd)
properties.synergy_rationale: Spacious planned layout with high school and academy density; evening parks and dining venues draw steady middle-class family dessert crowds.
properties.dominant_profile: Defense & Public Sector Officers, Aviation Tech Families, Students
properties.summary: Self-contained planned northern satellite commercial center with loyal family patronage.

properties.name: Vidyaranyapura Main Road Commercial Corridor
properties.category: Dense Neighborhood Retail & Fast Food Spine
properties.synergy_rationale: High-density linear bazaar serving BEL, HMT, and residential blocks; street food vendors and bakeries create steady post-dinner dessert demand.
properties.dominant_profile: PSU Retirees, Nuclear Families, Local College Youth
properties.summary: Bustling community retail spine with high pedestrian frequency and local brand loyalty.

properties.name: Banashankari 3rd Stage (Kathriguppe & BDA Complex) Commercial Hub
properties.synergy_rationale: Dense commercial junction connecting Banashankari to Ring Road; massive retail shopping and dining footprint serving South-West Bangalore.
properties.dominant_profile: Traditional Kannadiga Families, Transit Commuters, College Students (PES)
properties.summary: Major South-West retail nexus blending transit traffic with deep family residential spending.

properties.name: MG Road / Brigade Road / Church Street Central Business District
properties.category: Central Business District & Iconic Tourist High Street
properties.synergy_rationale: Bengaluru's legendary pedestrian promenade and nightlife center; Church Street weekend pedestrianization creates off-the-charts ice cream impulse buying.
properties.dominant_profile: Tourists, Cosmopolitan Youth, Expats, Corporate Executives
properties.summary: The premier citywide entertainment spine with unmatched pedestrian density.

properties.name: Electronic City Phase 1 & Neeladri Road IT Hub
properties.category: Corporate IT Hub & Young Resident High Street
properties.synergy_rationale: Global tech campuses (Infosys, Wipro) flank Neeladri Road high street; tech employees dine out late and drive massive weekend food delivery.
properties.dominant_profile: IT Engineers, Young Migrant Batchelors, Nuclear Tech Families
properties.summary: South Bangalore's massive technology hub with dedicated youth lifestyle strip.

properties.name: Marathahalli Multiplex & Outer Ring Road Commercial Hub
properties.synergy_rationale: Famous discount brand outlets and cinema multiplexes generate heavy foot traffic across Eastern Bangalore tech corridors.
properties.dominant_profile: Bargain Shoppers, Cinemagoers, Young Tech Workers
properties.summary: High-volume East Bangalore shopping and entertainment crossroads.

properties.name: Kalyan Nagar / HRBR Layout 80ft Road High Street
properties.synergy_rationale: Known as the 'Indiranagar of North Bangalore'; tree-lined food street packed with Korean bakeries, cafes, and late-night dessert joints.
properties.dominant_profile: Cosmopolitan Families, College Students, Expat Communities
properties.summary: North-East Bengaluru's premier food and leisure high street with heavy evening crowds.

properties.name: Rajajinagar Dr. Rajkumar Road & Orion Mall Node
properties.category: Premium Mall, Office Tower & Healthcare Hub
properties.synergy_rationale: Orion Mall lake promenade and Brigade Gateway offices create steady high-spending family leisure and dessert traffic.
properties.dominant_profile: Affluent Traditional Families, Corporate Employees, Mall Shoppers
properties.summary: High-capital commercial development anchoring North-West Bangalore retail.

properties.name: BTM Layout 100ft Road & 7th Main Commercial Corridor
properties.category: Student Fast Food & Coaching Institute Hub
properties.synergy_rationale: Extremely high concentration of coaching centers, IT job seekers, and affordable eateries; dessert parlors enjoy relentless small-group footfall.
properties.dominant_profile: Competitive Exam Students, IT Trainees, Young Techies
properties.summary: Student and coaching capital of South Bangalore with constant evening snacking traffic.

properties.name: Indiranagar Defence Colony & Leafy Enclave
properties.synergy_rationale: High per-capita disposable income; residents walk to 100ft Rd and 12th Main for premium artisanal ice cream treats.
properties.dominant_profile: Retired Armed Forces Officers, C-Suite Tech Leaders, Old Bangalore Elites
properties.summary: One of Bangalore's most prestigious and highest-spending residential neighbourhoods.

properties.name: HAL 2nd & 3rd Stage Planned Residential Layout
properties.synergy_rationale: Dense family catchment with top ICSE/CBSE schools nearby; steady weekend evening walking traffic into Apsara Indiranagar.
properties.dominant_profile: Nuclear Tech Families, Senior Defense Personnel, School Children
properties.summary: High-density affluent family residential heartland adjacent to 100ft Road.

properties.name: Appareddipalya & Doopanahalli Residential Pocket
properties.synergy_rationale: Directly behind Corner House and 100ft Road; residents walk down to 8th Cross and main road for late evening ice cream.
properties.dominant_profile: Young Working Tenants, Long-time Residents, Student Groups
properties.summary: Compact, walkable residential pocket providing continuous walk-in ice cream customers.

properties.name: Koramangala 3rd & 4th Block Elite Residential Enclave
properties.synergy_rationale: Home to India's top tech titans and venture capitalists; high propensity for family bulk tubs and premium flavour catering.
properties.dominant_profile: Tech Billionaires, Angel Investors, Business Magnates
properties.summary: India's highest net-worth residential sector with massive gourmet food spending.

properties.name: Koramangala 6th & 8th Block Residential Layout
properties.synergy_rationale: Bordering 5th Block food street; young tech couples and families step out onto 80ft and 100ft roads for post-dinner desserts.
properties.dominant_profile: Tech Founders, Consulting Couples, Long-term Resident Families
properties.summary: High-density residential neighborhood with direct pedestrian access to Koramangala's top food strips.

properties.name: HSR Layout Sectors 1, 2 & 3 Planned Residential Sectors
properties.category: Planned Family BDA Layout & Independent Houses
properties.peak_window: 5:30 PM – 10:00 PM (Park Walks & Evening Ice Cream)
properties.synergy_rationale: High density of young children, schools, and family parks; strong weekend tradition of after-dinner family ice cream trips.
properties.dominant_profile: Upper-Middle Class Tech Families, School Children, Grandparents
properties.summary: The family residential core of HSR Layout with massive demand for fruit and kulfi scoops.

properties.name: HSR Layout Sectors 4, 6 & 7 Tree-Lined Enclave
properties.category: Quiet Residential Layout & Modern Gated Apartments
properties.synergy_rationale: Flanks 27th Main food spine; residents walk to restaurants and conclude dinner with Apsara natural fruit ice creams.
properties.dominant_profile: Software Architects, Senior Managers, Young Couples with Kids
properties.summary: Affluent leafy sectors directly feeding into 27th Main high-street retail.

properties.name: Jayanagar 3rd & 4th 'T' Block Heritage Residential Enclave
properties.synergy_rationale: Deep cultural affinity for natural, vegetarian milk-fat ice creams; multiple generations walk together after temple visits and shopping.
properties.dominant_profile: Traditional Kannadiga Families, Doctors, Business Owners, Grandparents
properties.summary: Historic, leafy South Bangalore enclave with loyal patronage for authentic fruit desserts.

properties.name: Jayanagar 5th, 7th & 8th Block Residential Layout
properties.synergy_rationale: High concentration of vegetarian households seeking pure, preservative-free artisanal ice creams like guava with chilli.
properties.dominant_profile: Multi-generational Families, Software Professionals, College Students
properties.summary: Dense residential block forming the southern catchment of Jayanagar retail.

properties.name: NR Colony, Bugle Rock & Bull Temple Heritage Enclave
properties.synergy_rationale: High intellectual and cultural heritage; evening walkers in Bugle Rock Park naturally flow onto DVG Road for sweet treats.
properties.dominant_profile: Academicians, Writers, Retired Scientists, Heritage Families
properties.summary: The cultural epicenter of Old Bangalore with deep family roots and walking culture.

properties.name: Shankarapuram & Visvesvarapuram Residential Pocket
properties.peak_window: 6:00 PM – 10:30 PM (VV Puram Food Street Surges)
properties.synergy_rationale: Directly borders VV Puram Thindi Beedi (Food Street); massive pedestrian sweet cravings following savory dosas and bhajjis.
properties.dominant_profile: Traditional Families, Food Pilgrims, Students
properties.summary: Legendary food and residential precinct driving huge evening dessert demand.

properties.name: JP Nagar 1st, 2nd & 3rd Phase Planned Layouts
properties.synergy_rationale: Established residential phases with peaceful avenues; strong household demand for after-dinner ice cream take-home tubs.
properties.dominant_profile: Established Resident Families, Government Officers, Software Leads
properties.summary: Planned, affluent South Bangalore family enclave with high evening leisure activity.

properties.name: JP Nagar 6th & 7th Phase (Dollars Colony) Gated Enclave
properties.synergy_rationale: High concentration of luxury villas and gated communities; strong purchasing power and high average order value (AOV).
properties.dominant_profile: Entrepreneurs, Tech Executives, NRI Returned Families
properties.summary: Ultra-wealthy residential pocket with high demand for premium scoops and family sundae packs.

properties.name: Prestige Shantiniketan & High-Rise Tech Township
properties.synergy_rationale: Over 3,000 apartment units in a single gated township; enormous concentration of young tech children and weekend mall visitors.
properties.dominant_profile: Tech Couples, Young Children, Dual-Income Households
properties.summary: India's highest-density tech apartment township generating unstoppable weekend dessert demand.

properties.name: Palm Meadows & Whitefield Luxury Villa Communities
properties.synergy_rationale: Expatriates and senior MNC leaders; high home delivery volume and party catering orders.
properties.dominant_profile: C-Suite Corporate Leaders, Expat Families, Tech Founders
properties.summary: Bangalore's original gated luxury villa enclave with top-tier disposable income.

properties.name: Hope Farm & Channasandra Rapid Growth Residential Belt
properties.category: Modern Apartment Complexes & Metro Connected Housing
properties.synergy_rationale: Terminus of the Purple Line Metro extension; massive wave of newly occupied high-rise apartments with young families.
properties.dominant_profile: First-time Homebuyer Tech Couples, Toddlers, Commuters
properties.summary: Rapidly urbanising residential belt packed with young children and working parents.

properties.name: Green Glen Layout & Bellandur Lake Residential Enclave
properties.category: Dense Tech Apartment Township & Walkable Pockets
properties.peak_window: 7:00 PM – 11:30 PM (Late Night Tech Deliveries & Walks)
properties.synergy_rationale: Walking distance from ORR tech parks; young tech couples with immense disposable income dine out daily and consume ice cream late into the night.
properties.dominant_profile: IT Engineers, Fintech Professionals, Young Parents
properties.summary: Vibrant, tech-centric residential hub with one of India's highest dessert delivery frequencies.

properties.name: Malleshwaram 1st to 18th Cross Traditional Residential Blocks
properties.synergy_rationale: Multi-generational families with deep cultural pride; high demand for pure vegetarian, traditional faloodas, and real fruit sorbets.
properties.dominant_profile: Traditional Kannadiga Families, Teachers, Artists, Businessmen
properties.summary: Heritage North-West Bangalore family bastion with high loyalty to authentic culinary brands.

properties.name: Sadashivanagar Elite VIP Residential Enclave
properties.synergy_rationale: Bangalore's most exclusive address; high volume of private party catering and premium bulk takeaway orders.
properties.dominant_profile: Ministers, Judges, Industrialists, Senior Doctors
properties.summary: Bangalore's traditional power address commanding the city's highest household net worth.

properties.name: Hennur Gardens & HRBR Extension Residential Enclave
properties.synergy_rationale: High density of international schools and NRI returnees; parents prioritize premium fruit ice creams for weekend family outings.
properties.dominant_profile: NRI Families, Academic Faculty, Corporate Executives
properties.summary: Cosmopolitan North-East family layout with high disposable spending.

properties.name: Kothanur, Geddalahalli & Byrathi Apartment Township Belt
properties.synergy_rationale: Large gated townships (Mantri Webcity, Purva) with thousands of young children; high weekend parlor visit rates.
properties.dominant_profile: Young IT Couples, Tech Park Commuters, School Students
properties.summary: Vast family residential expansion belt directly anchoring Apsara Hennur.

properties.name: Yelahanka New Town Planned Residential Sectors (A, B & 4th Phase)
properties.category: Planned Township Sectors, Defense & PSU Enclaves
properties.synergy_rationale: Wide tree-lined avenues with sports grounds and defense colonies; strong family dining and dessert culture on weekends.
properties.dominant_profile: Air Force & Defense Personnel, Rail Wheel Engineers, Families
properties.summary: Organized northern residential community with deep family roots and sports recreation.

properties.name: Judicial Layout & Kogilu Road Gated Communities
properties.category: Affluent Gated Villas & Judicial Officers Colony
properties.synergy_rationale: Prestigious judicial and bureaucratic community with top private school connections; high disposable income for artisanal desserts.
properties.dominant_profile: Judicial Officers, Lawyers, Senior Executives, Aviation Professionals
properties.summary: Affluent, tranquil residential enclave in North Bangalore.

properties.name: Vidyaranyapura Residential Blocks 1 to 5 & BEL Layout
properties.category: Peaceful Family BDA Layout & Public Sector Retirees
properties.synergy_rationale: High concentration of retired scientists and middle-class nuclear families; strong weekend evening demand for natural fruit ice creams.
properties.dominant_profile: BEL & ISRO Engineers, University Faculty, Middle-Class Families
properties.summary: Well-established family neighborhood with quiet residential streets.

properties.name: Banashankari 2nd Stage & Padmanabhanagar Residential Enclave
properties.synergy_rationale: Devagiri temple complex draws tens of thousands of weekend devotees; strong post-prayer sweet indulgence tradition.
properties.dominant_profile: Traditional Families, Business Families, PES University Students
properties.summary: South-West Bangalore's cultural anchor with immense weekend family footfall.

properties.name: BTM Layout 1st & 2nd Stage Residential Enclave
properties.synergy_rationale: Immense density of young IT employees and students living in shared apartments; unmatched late-night dessert delivery velocity.
properties.dominant_profile: Junior Software Engineers, Tech Students, Young Bachelors
properties.summary: High-velocity youth housing zone generating continuous nighttime delivery orders.

properties.name: Sahakarnagar & Judicial Layout Residential Enclave
properties.synergy_rationale: High-spending North Bangalore residential community with bustling dining streets and family leisure activities.
properties.dominant_profile: Senior Corporate Managers, Tech Leaders, Doctors
properties.summary: Premier North Bangalore residential pocket with strong family food culture.

properties.name: Cookes Town, Richards Town & Fraser Town Residential Enclave
properties.category: Colonial Heritage Enclave & Gourmet Food Culture
properties.synergy_rationale: Historic Anglo-Indian and cosmopolitan enclaves famous for meat delicacies and bakeries; natural affinity for premium desserts.
properties.dominant_profile: Old Bangalore Cosmopolitans, Expatriates, Food Connoisseurs
properties.summary: Charm-filled heritage cantonment neighborhood with high appreciation for culinary quality.

properties.name: Sarjapur Road High-Rise Apartment Belt (Kaikondrahalli & Carmelaram)
properties.category: High-Rise Tech Family Communities & School Hub
properties.synergy_rationale: Highest concentration of international schools and gated residential towers in East Bangalore; massive children and family dessert market.
properties.dominant_profile: Tech Leads, Young Parents, Toddlers and Pre-teens
properties.summary: Immense family residential growth corridor packed with young tech-worker families.
